answer: In a distributed multi-agent system, the spectral partition barrier acts as an insurmountable canyon that prevents personalized PageRank decay from bleeding into adversary nodes. Honest subgraphs form a dense crystal lattice of trust, while Sybil clusters remain isolated on a topological island. By pairing this attenuation with cryptoeconomic primitives—where staking collateral is subjected to slashing penalties via a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function—we prove a negative expected attack utility, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium.
